extraction_notes: 4401.10 = India-retained legacy code for fuel wood, coniferous (pre-HS2022 split). HS2022 replaced with 4401.11/.12.
Coniferous fuel wood in log form (4401.11).
Coniferous fuel wood — billets, faggots, twigs and similar (residual under 4401.11).
Non-coniferous fuel wood in log form (4401.12).
Non-coniferous fuel wood — billets, faggots, twigs (residual under 4401.12).
Coniferous wood in chips/particles (4401.21) — typically pulp/panel feedstock.
Non-coniferous wood in chips/particles (4401.22).
Wood pellets — agglomerated sawdust/wood waste for fuel (heating systems, industrial boilers).
Wood briquettes — compressed sawdust/wood waste for fuel.
Other agglomerated forms (not pellet/briquette) — e.g., agglomerated logs.
Loose sawdust — not agglomerated (4401.41).
Other wood waste/scrap, not agglomerated (4401.49) — shavings, off-cuts, scrap.
Bamboo charcoal (4402.10) — popular Indian/Asian fuel + activated-carbon precursor.
Coconut shell charcoal — Indian-specific tariff line (key activated-carbon feedstock; major Indian export).
Other charcoal of vegetable origin (4402.20.90) — residual.
Coniferous wood in the rough, treated with paint/stains/creosote/preservatives (4403.11).
Non-coniferous wood in the rough, treated with preservatives (4403.12).
4403.21 = coniferous pine (Pinus spp), untreated, cross-section >=15cm. .10 = saw/veneer logs.
Pine poles/pilings/posts (4403.21.20) — utility-pole class of round wood.
Other pine in the rough (residual under 4403.21).
4403.22 = pine (Pinus spp), other (smaller dimension). .10 = saw/veneer logs.
Pine poles/pilings/posts in smaller dimension class (4403.22.20).
Other pine in the rough, smaller dimension class (4403.22.90 residual).
4403.23 = fir (Abies)/spruce (Picea), cross-section >=15cm. .10 = saw/veneer logs.
Fir/spruce poles/pilings/posts (4403.23.20).
Other fir/spruce in the rough (4403.23.90 residual).
4403.24 = fir/spruce, smaller dimension class. .10 = saw/veneer logs.
Fir/spruce poles/pilings/posts, smaller dimension (4403.24.20).
Other fir/spruce in the rough, smaller dimension (residual under 4403.24).
4403.25 = other coniferous (not pine/fir/spruce), cross-section >=15cm — e.g., cedar, larch, hemlock. .10 = saw/veneer logs.
Other coniferous (cedar/larch/hemlock-class) poles/pilings/posts.
Other coniferous wood in the rough (4403.25.90 residual).
4403.26 = other coniferous, smaller dimension. .10 = saw/veneer logs.
Other coniferous poles/pilings/posts, smaller dimension (4403.26.20).
Other coniferous wood in the rough, smaller dimension (residual under 4403.26).
Dark/Light Red Meranti, Meranti Bakau — tropical hardwood per Ch.44 Subheading Note 2 (Shorea spp.).
Teak (Tectona grandis) logs — premium tropical hardwood, major Indian import from Myanmar/Africa.
Other tropical wood logs (residual under 4403.4 — non-meranti, non-teak tropical hardwoods per Subheading Note 2).
Oak (Quercus spp.) in the rough — temperate hardwood, used for furniture/flooring/cooperage.
Beech (Fagus spp.), cross-section >=15cm.
Beech (Fagus spp.), smaller dimension class.
Birch (Betula spp.), cross-section >=15cm. Birch is the dominant plywood-veneer hardwood in Europe.
Birch (Betula spp.), smaller dimension class.
Poplar/aspen (Populus spp.) — soft hardwood for matchsticks/packaging/plywood.
Eucalyptus (Eucalyptus spp.) — major Indian plantation species; pulp/sawing/construction.
Andaman Padauk — Indian-specific tariff line, endemic Andamans hardwood (Pterocarpus dalbergioides).
Bonsum (Phoebe goalparensis) — Assam/NE India tropical hardwood, Indian-specific tariff line.
Gurgan/Gurjan (Dipterocarpus alatus) — tropical hardwood, Indian-specific tariff line.
Khair (Acacia catechu) — Indian-specific tariff line; source of katha/catechu used in paan and tanning.
Lampati (Duabanga grandiflora) — Indian-specific tariff line, NE India/Andamans softwood-like hardwood.
Indian Laurel (Terminalia alata / T. tomentosa, Saaj/Asna) — Indian-specific tariff line.
Paliwood (Palaquium ellipticum) — Western Ghats tropical hardwood, Indian-specific tariff line.
Red Sanders (Pterocarpus santalinus) — Indian-specific tariff line; CITES Appendix II + DGFT export-restricted species (Andhra-Pradesh endemic).
Indian Rosewood (Dalbergia latifolia) — Indian-specific tariff line; CITES Appendix II + DGFT export-restricted.
Sal (Shorea robusta) — major Indian construction hardwood, sleeper-grade. Indian-specific tariff line in named-species group.
Sandalwood (Santalum album) — Indian-specific tariff line; CITES Appendix II species; export-restricted by DGFT.
Semul (Bombax ceiba, silk cotton tree) — soft Indian hardwood, Indian-specific tariff line.
Walnut wood (Juglans regia/binata) — Kashmir handicraft/furniture wood, Indian-specific tariff line.
Anjam (Hardwickia binata) — dense Indian hardwood (heaviest after iron-wood), Indian-specific tariff line.
Sissoo/Sheesham (Dalbergia sissoo) — premier Indian furniture wood, Indian-specific tariff line. CITES Appendix II.
White cedar (Dysoxylum malabaricum) — Western Ghats endemic, Indian-specific tariff line.
Other wood in the rough (residual catch-all 4403.99.90).
4404.10 = coniferous hoopwood, split poles, pickets, palings (basic shaped non-sawn wood).
Non-coniferous roughly-trimmed sticks/blanks for walking sticks, tool handles, pickets — Indian split under 4404.20.
Drawn wood — wooden rods pulled through dies to uniform diameter; Indian-specific tariff line under 4404.20.
Other non-coniferous hoopwood/split poles/pickets/palings (residual under 4404.20).
Heading 4405 covers two products: wood wool (excelsior — long shavings for packaging/upholstery) and wood flour (fine wood powder for fillers/panel manufacture).
Coniferous railway/tramway sleepers, NOT impregnated (4406.11). intended_role=support (load-bearing track infrastructure).
Non-coniferous railway/tramway sleepers, NOT impregnated (4406.12) — e.g., Sal/teak sleepers used by Indian Railways historically.
Coniferous railway sleepers, IMPREGNATED (typically creosote-treated for rot/insect resistance). 4406.91.
Non-coniferous railway sleepers, IMPREGNATED (4406.92).
Pine (Pinus spp.) sawn lumber, thickness >6mm (heading 4407 definition).
Fir (Abies spp.) and spruce (Picea spp.) sawn lumber, >6mm thickness.
S-P-F = Spruce-Pine-Fir, a North American mixed-species commercial framing-lumber grade.
Hem-fir = Western hemlock (Tsuga heterophylla) + true firs (Abies spp.), N. American commercial grade.
Douglas fir (Pseudotsuga menziesii) — Indian split under 4407.19; premium structural softwood.
Other coniferous sawn wood (residual under 4407.19 — non-Douglas-fir, non-pine, non-fir/spruce, non-hemlock).
Mahogany (Swietenia spp.) sawn — tropical wood per Subheading Note 2; CITES Appendix II.
Virola/Imbuia/Balsa — South American tropical hardwoods per Subheading Note 2. Balsa = lightest commercial wood.
Teak (Tectona grandis) sawn lumber — premium tropical hardwood, marine/decking applications.
Dark/Light Red Meranti, Meranti Bakau sawn (Shorea spp.) — SE Asian tropical hardwood per Subheading Note 2.
White Lauan/White Meranti/White Seraya/Yellow Meranti/Alan — SE Asian Shorea/Parashorea spp. per Subheading Note 2.
Sapelli/Sapele (Entandrophragma cylindricum) — African tropical hardwood per Subheading Note 2.
Iroko (Milicia excelsa) — African tropical hardwood (teak-substitute) per Subheading Note 2.
Other tropical wood sawn (residual under 4407.2 — tropical hardwoods per Subheading Note 2 not separately specified).
Oak (Quercus spp.) sawn lumber — premium temperate hardwood.
Beech (Fagus spp.) sawn lumber.
Maple (Acer spp.) sawn lumber.
Cherry (Prunus spp.) sawn lumber — fine cabinet hardwood.
Ash (Fraxinus spp.) sawn lumber — used for tool handles, baseball bats, hockey sticks.
Birch (Betula spp.) sawn lumber.
Poplar/aspen (Populus spp.) sawn lumber.
Willow (Salix spp.) — Indian-specific tariff line; Kashmir willow is the premier cricket-bat wood.
Other non-coniferous, non-tropical, non-named-species sawn wood (residual under 4407.99).
4408.10 = coniferous veneer/sheets <=6mm. .10 = sheets for plywood (Indian split).
Oak wood veneer under 4408.10 — Indian split (though oak is typically non-coniferous, this Indian sub-line was placed under 4408.10 in the schedule).
Veneer sheets for match boxes and match splints — Indian-specific tariff line; match industry feedstock (typically softwood like Pinus or Bombax).
Other coniferous veneer sheets (residual under 4408.10).
4408.31 = Dark/Light Red Meranti, Meranti Bakau veneer per Subheading Note 2. .10 = sheets for plywood.
Rose wood veneer sheets — Indian-specific tariff line under 4408.31 (Note: rosewood is not strictly meranti class, but India placed this here).
Veneer for match boxes/splints — Indian-specific tariff line within 4408.31 (meranti-class tropical wood).
Other meranti-class tropical veneer (residual under 4408.31).
4408.39 = other tropical wood veneer (non-meranti). .10 = sheets for plywood.
Rose wood veneer sheets — Indian-specific tariff line under 4408.39 (other tropical).
Other tropical veneer for match boxes/splints — Indian-specific tariff line under 4408.39.
Other tropical veneer (residual under 4408.39).
4408.90 = other (non-coniferous, non-tropical) veneer. .10 = sheets for plywood.
Other veneer for match boxes/splints — Indian-specific tariff line under 4408.90.
Other veneer sheets (residual under 4408.90).
4409.10 = coniferous continuously-shaped wood. .10 = planed/T&G/rebated/chamfered/V-jointed boards but not further moulded.
Coniferous mouldings/beadings/skirting boards (4409.10.20).
Other coniferous continuously-shaped wood (residual under 4409.10).
Bamboo continuously-shaped (4409.21) — bamboo flooring strips/parquet feedstock.
Tropical hardwood continuously-shaped (4409.22) — premium tropical flooring/moulding feedstock per Subheading Note 2.
4409.29 = other non-coniferous (non-bamboo, non-tropical). .10 = planed/T&G boards not further moulded.
Non-coniferous mouldings/beadings/skirting (4409.29.20).
Other non-coniferous continuously-shaped wood (residual under 4409.29).
4410.11 = particle board of wood. .10 = plain (no surface treatment) — Indian split.
Insulation board and hardboard under particle-board 4410.11.20 — Indian split (Note: hardboard typically classified under 4411 fibreboard, but Indian schedule has this split here).
Veneered particle board without decorative veneer faces (4410.11.30) — Indian split.
Other wood particle board (residual under 4410.11).
4410.12 = oriented strand board (OSB). .10 = unworked or not further worked than sanded.
Other OSB (worked beyond sanding — laminated/edge-banded/etc.).
Other particle/strand board of wood (residual under 4410.1 — non-particle/non-OSB types, e.g., waferboard).
4410.90 = particle/strand board of OTHER (non-wood) ligneous materials (bagasse, flax, etc.). .10 = plain.
Insulation board/hardboard of other ligneous (non-wood) materials.
Veneered particle board (non-wood ligneous core) without decorative veneer faces (4410.90.30).
Coir-based particle board (4410.90.40) — Indian-specific tariff line; coir-particle board is a domestic Indian product (KVIC).
Jute-fibre particle board (4410.90.50) — Indian-specific tariff line; jute-stick particle board is a Bengal/Assam product.
Other particle board of ligneous materials (residual under 4410.90 — e.g., bagasse, flax, hemp).
Medium Density Fibreboard (MDF), thickness <=5mm. MDF density 0.5-0.8 g/cm3.
MDF, thickness >5mm but <=9mm.
MDF, thickness >9mm.
4411.92 = HDF (density >0.8 g/cm3). .11 = hardboard, not mechanically worked or surface covered (Indian split).
Other HDF, not mechanically worked or surface covered (residual under 4411.92 not-worked group).
HDF hardboard, worked or surface-covered (e.g., laminated, painted, melamine-faced).
Other HDF, worked or surface-covered (residual under 4411.92 worked group).
4411.93 = fibreboard density 0.5-0.8 g/cm3 (other than MDF). .11 = insulation board not worked.
Other fibreboard 0.5-0.8 density, not worked (residual).
Insulation board worked/surface-covered under 4411.93.
Other fibreboard 0.5-0.8 density worked/surface-covered (residual).
4411.94 = fibreboard density <=0.5 g/cm3 (LDF/softboard). .11 = insulation board not worked.
Other LDF, not worked (residual).
Insulation board (LDF) worked/surface-covered under 4411.94.
Coir fibreboard (4411.94.22) — Indian-specific tariff line; coir-board is a domestic KVIC product.
Jute fibreboard (4411.94.23) — Indian-specific tariff line; jute fibre panel.
Other LDF worked/surface-covered (residual under 4411.94).
4412.10 = plywood, veneered panels and similar laminated wood, of bamboo.
4412.31 = plywood consisting solely of sheets of wood, each ply <=6mm, at least one outer ply of tropical wood. .10 = decorative plywood (Indian split).
Tea chest panels/shooks (4412.31.20) — Indian-specific tariff line; plywood pre-cut sets for tea-chest assembly. intended_role=packaging.
Other tea chest panels (not in pre-packed sets) — Indian-specific tariff line.
Marine and aircraft plywood (4412.31.40) — Indian-specific tariff line. Marine plywood = BWP-grade per IS:710; phenolic-bonded.
Cuttings/trimmings of plywood, width <=5cm (4412.31.50) — Indian-specific scrap/edge-trim line.
Other commercial plywood with tropical wood outer ply (residual under 4412.31).

4412.33 = plywood, each ply <=6mm, with at least one outer ply of non-coniferous wood (specific named species incl. alder/ash/beech/birch/cherry/chestnut/elm/eucalyptus/hickory/maple/oak/plane/poplar/aspen/black-locust/tulipwood). .10 = decorative.
Tea chest panels/shooks of non-coniferous plywood (4412.33.20).
Marine/aircraft plywood with non-coniferous outer ply (4412.33.30).
Cuttings/trimmings of plywood (non-coniferous outer ply), width <=5cm.
Other commercial plywood with non-coniferous (named-species) outer ply (residual under 4412.33).
4412.34 = plywood, each ply <=6mm, with at least one outer ply of OTHER non-coniferous wood (not in 4412.33 named-species list). .10 = decorative.
Tea chest panels of other non-coniferous plywood under 4412.34.
Marine/aircraft plywood under 4412.34.
Cuttings/trimmings of plywood under 4412.34, width <=5cm.
Other commercial plywood under 4412.34 (residual).
4412.39 = plywood, each ply <=6mm, with both outer plies of coniferous wood. .10 = decorative.
Tea chest panels under coniferous plywood 4412.39.
Marine/aircraft plywood under coniferous 4412.39.
Cuttings/trimmings of coniferous plywood under 4412.39, width <=5cm.
Other commercial coniferous plywood (residual under 4412.39).
4412.41 = Laminated Veneer Lumber (LVL) with at least one outer ply of tropical wood — engineered laminated structural product.
LVL with non-coniferous outer ply (other than tropical) — 4412.42.
LVL with both outer plies of coniferous wood — 4412.49.
4412.51 = blockboard/laminboard/battenboard with tropical-wood outer ply — solid-wood-core panels for door/furniture cores.
Blockboard/laminboard/battenboard with non-coniferous outer ply — 4412.52.
Blockboard/laminboard/battenboard with both outer plies of coniferous wood — 4412.59.
4412.91 = other plywood/laminated wood with at least one outer ply of tropical wood (not under 4412.31 or 4412.41/51). .10 = decorative plywood.
Tea chest panels/shooks (Indian split under 4412.91 — other plywood with tropical wood outer ply).
Marine/aircraft plywood under 4412.91.
Cuttings/trimmings under 4412.91, width <=5cm.
Other plywood under 4412.91 (residual).
4412.92 = other plywood/laminated wood with at least one outer ply of non-coniferous (non-tropical). .10 = decorative plywood.
Tea chest panels under 4412.92.
Marine/aircraft plywood under 4412.92.
Cuttings/trimmings of plywood under 4412.92, width <=5cm.
4412.99 = other (with both outer plies of coniferous wood, not LVL/blockboard). .10 = decorative plywood.
Tea chest panels under 4412.99 (coniferous plywood).
Marine/aircraft plywood under 4412.99 (coniferous).
Cuttings/trimmings of coniferous plywood under 4412.99, width <=5cm.
Other plywood/laminated wood (residual under 4412.99).

4413 = densified wood (Ch.44 Note 6): wood chemically/physically treated to increase density/hardness, in blocks/plates/strips/profile shapes. Used for bearings, gears, shuttles. Single national code 4413.00.00.
4414 = wooden frames for paintings, photographs, mirrors or similar objects. .10 = of tropical wood (per Subheading Note 2 list — teak, meranti, etc.).
Wooden picture/photo/mirror frames of wood other than tropical (4414.90) — e.g., pine, oak, mango wood.
4415.10 = wooden cases, boxes, crates, drums and similar packings; cable-drums. intended_role=packaging per Ch.44 schema rule (ISPM-15 phytosanitary heat-treatment relevant for export).
4415.20 = wooden pallets, box pallets, other load boards and pallet collars. intended_role=packaging (load-handling subset of heading 4415; ISPM-15 export relevant).
4416 = casks, barrels, vats, tubs and other coopers products and parts (incl. staves). .10 = the assembled casks/barrels/vats/tubs. intended_role=packaging per Ch.44 schema rule.
Other coopers products (4416.00.20) — coopered wooden containers other than the named casks/barrels/vats/tubs. intended_role=packaging.
Parts of cooperage (4416.00.91) — riven or sawn staves of wood, not further prepared. Component for cask/barrel manufacture. intended_role=packaging (4416 family).
Other parts of cooperage (4416.00.99 residual) — coopers parts other than riven/sawn staves (e.g., hoops of wood, headings). intended_role=packaging.
4417 = tools, tool bodies, tool handles, broom/brush bodies and handles of wood; boot/shoe lasts and trees of wood. Single national code 4417.00.00. intended_role=NULL (not packaging/support).
4418 = builders joinery and carpentry of wood. .11 = windows, French-windows and frames, of tropical wood. intended_role=support per Ch.44 builders-joinery schema rule.
Windows, French-windows and their frames of wood other than tropical (4418.19). intended_role=support.
4418.21 = doors and their frames and thresholds, of tropical wood. .10 = flush doors (hollow/solid-core flat-faced doors). intended_role=support.
Frames and thresholds of flush doors, tropical wood (4418.21.20). intended_role=support.
Other doors/frames/thresholds of tropical wood (4418.21.90 residual — panelled/carved doors etc.). intended_role=support.
4418.29 = doors/frames/thresholds of wood other than tropical. .10 = flush doors. intended_role=support.
Frames and thresholds of flush doors, non-tropical wood (4418.29.20). intended_role=support.
Other doors/frames/thresholds of non-tropical wood (4418.29.90 residual — panelled/carved doors). intended_role=support.
4418.30 = posts and beams (other than engineered products of 4418.81-4418.89). Solid-wood structural members. intended_role=support.
4418.40 = shuttering for concrete constructional work (formwork). intended_role=support per Ch.44 builders-joinery/formwork schema rule.
4418.50 = shingles and shakes (wooden roof/wall tiles). Builders carpentry under heading 4418. intended_role=support.
4418.73 = assembled flooring panels of bamboo or with at least the top wear-layer of bamboo. intended_role=support (flooring is builders joinery under 4418).
4418.74 = assembled flooring panels for mosaic floors (non-bamboo). intended_role=support.
4418.75 = other multilayer assembled flooring panels (engineered wood flooring). intended_role=support.
Other assembled flooring panels (4418.79 residual — single-layer/solid non-mosaic). intended_role=support.
4418.81 = glue-laminated timber (glulam) — engineered structural timber product (new HS2022 subheading). intended_role=support.
4418.82 = cross-laminated timber (CLT / X-lam) — engineered structural timber product. intended_role=support.
4418.83 = wooden I-beams (I-joists) — engineered structural timber product. intended_role=support.
4418.89 = other engineered structural timber products (e.g., LVL — laminated veneer lumber, PSL). intended_role=support.
4418.91 = other builders joinery and carpentry of bamboo (not windows/doors/posts/flooring/engineered). intended_role=support.
4418.92 = cellular wood panels (hollow-core lightweight building panels). Listed under engineered structural timber products group. intended_role=support.
Other builders joinery and carpentry of wood (4418.99 residual — non-bamboo, not elsewhere specified). intended_role=support.
4419 = tableware and kitchenware of wood. .11 = of bamboo, bread boards/chopping boards and similar boards. intended_role=NULL.
4419.12 = chopsticks of bamboo (new HS2022 subheading). Tableware under 4419. intended_role=NULL.
Other tableware/kitchenware of bamboo (4419.19 residual — spoons, bowls, trivets etc.). intended_role=NULL.
4419.20 = tableware and kitchenware of tropical wood (per Subheading Note 2 — teak, etc.). intended_role=NULL.
4419.90 = tableware/kitchenware of wood other than bamboo/tropical. .10 = bread boards, chopping boards and similar boards. intended_role=NULL.
Chopsticks of wood other than bamboo (4419.90.20). intended_role=NULL.
Other tableware/kitchenware of wood (4419.90.90 residual — spoons, bowls, ladles, trivets etc.). intended_role=NULL.

4420 = wood marquetry/inlaid wood; caskets/cases for jewellery/cutlery; statuettes and other ornaments; wooden furniture not in Ch.94. .11 = statuettes and other ornaments of tropical wood. Major Indian handicraft export. intended_role=NULL.
Statuettes and other ornaments of wood other than tropical (4420.19) — e.g., sheesham/mango wood carvings. Major Indian handicraft export. intended_role=NULL.
4420.90.10 = wood marquetry and inlaid wood. Decorative assembled-veneer work. intended_role=NULL.
Other articles of heading 4420 (4420.90.90 residual) — caskets/cases for jewellery or cutlery, and similar decorative articles; wooden furniture not falling in Ch.94. intended_role=NULL.
4421 = other articles of wood (residual heading). .10 = clothes hangers. intended_role=NULL.
4421.20 = coffins (new HS2022 subheading). Other article of wood under heading 4421. intended_role=NULL.
4421.91 = other articles of wood, of bamboo. .11 = spools/cops/bobbins/sewing-thread reels of turned wood, for cotton machinery. intended_role=NULL.
Other spools/cops/bobbins/reels of turned bamboo, not for cotton machinery (4421.91.19). intended_role=NULL.
Wood paving blocks of bamboo (4421.91.20). Other article of wood under 4421.91. intended_role=NULL.
Match splints of bamboo (4421.91.30) — feedstock for match-stick manufacture. intended_role=NULL.
Pencil slats of bamboo (4421.91.40) — slats for pencil manufacture. intended_role=NULL.
Parts of wood (bamboo) — oars, paddles and rudders for ships, boats and other floating structures (4421.91.50). intended_role=NULL.
Parts of domestic decorative articles used as tableware and kitchenware, of bamboo (4421.91.60). intended_role=NULL.
Articles of densified wood (bamboo-based) not included/specified elsewhere (4421.91.70). intended_role=NULL.
Other articles of wood of bamboo (4421.91.90 residual). intended_role=NULL.
4421.99 = other articles of wood, other (non-bamboo). .11 = spools/cops/bobbins/reels of turned wood, for cotton machinery. intended_role=NULL.
Spools/cops/bobbins of turned wood for jute machinery (4421.99.12) — India-specific (major jute industry). intended_role=NULL.
Spools/cops/bobbins of turned wood for silk, regenerated and synthetic fibre machinery (4421.99.13). intended_role=NULL.
Spools/cops/bobbins of turned wood for other machinery (4421.99.14). intended_role=NULL.
Other spools/cops/bobbins/reels of turned wood (4421.99.19 residual). intended_role=NULL.
Wood paving blocks, non-bamboo (4421.99.20). intended_role=NULL.
Match splints of wood, non-bamboo (4421.99.30) — feedstock for match manufacture (significant Indian cottage industry). intended_role=NULL.
Pencil slats of wood, non-bamboo (4421.99.40) — typically of soft cedar/pine; India is a major pencil-slat producer. intended_role=NULL.
Parts of wood (non-bamboo) — oars, paddles and rudders for ships, boats and other floating structures (4421.99.50). intended_role=NULL.
Parts of domestic decorative articles used as tableware and kitchenware, non-bamboo wood (4421.99.60). intended_role=NULL.
Articles of densified wood not included/specified elsewhere, non-bamboo (4421.99.70). intended_role=NULL.
Other articles of wood (4421.99.90) — the catch-all residual for Ch.44 (any wooden article not specified elsewhere). intended_role=NULL.
